message: Hi, I'm a student with a shell programming certification background. My overall academic average is 71.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and cloud computing. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 1700 per year. I live in Pune. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program in Delhi focuses on Big Data Analytics, directly matching your interest in data engineering. It has a low tuition cost ($800) and is accessible with your current academic average (71.9% > 63%), making it a strong fit for job prospects.

Located in Coimbatore, this MSc Big Data Analytics program is another excellent match for your data engineering interest. The tuition ($1300) is well within budget, and the minimum grade requirement (62%) is easily met by your current average.

The MCA program in Coimbatore offers data science analytics and software engineering fields. While it requires a CS background, its low tuition ($1350) and relevant curriculum make it a solid option for improving job prospects.

This MTech in Pune covers networking and cloud computing, aligning perfectly with your interests. Although the tuition ($2050) slightly exceeds your budget, its high median starting salary ($15192) makes it a worthwhile consideration for maximizing job outcomes.

This MBA in Hyderabad combines IT management and software engineering. It is highly affordable ($1250) and has a low minimum grade requirement (74%), offering a good balance of cost and career relevance for someone unsure of their exact tech path.
